S1 — MATERIAL (P2), packages/core/src/character/creationClassChoices.ts:333-335; affected consumer packages/cli/src/characterWizard.ts:1006-1018 and :1047-1056. The new empty optional language choice is correctly satisfied for finalization, but the actual creation wizard equates satisfied with already answered. Concrete scenario: create a Human Ranger choosing humanoids and gnoll/orc, then enter the Favored Enemy language group with no language selected. Its entire display is "Favored Enemy: choose 1 (favored-enemy-language)" followed by "Selected:  — Enter to keep, or clear to choose again."; no language options appear. Entering the advertised clear command prints "Cleared." then "Selected: ." and returns advance without consuming the next intended language answer. Clearing an existing language likewise skips re-picking. Consequently the normal numbered-option/clear-to-repick flow cannot collect the language and can remove a previously selected grant. A player who guesses a legal name directly can still select it; the defect is specifically the hidden menu and broken advertised repick transition, not the core persistence API.

Invariant/authority: the bead requires the associated language to be offered/collected at creation, with an intentional empty skip; the existing guided creation consumer promises numbered choices and clear-to-repick. Optional satisfaction must not stand in for a user decision to skip or for a populated answer. Owner/fix: adapt runChoiceGroup to recognize optional empty states, show available language options with an explicit blank-to-skip prompt, and keep clear/reset in the picker rather than auto-advancing. Preserve satisfied=true in the engine so optional choices still do not block finalization. Permanent evidence: a generalized optional-choice wizard regression covering initial empty display, explicit skip, legal selection/persistence, and clear/re-pick of a populated choice. One consumer-level invariant is proportionate; no broad snapshot is needed. Sibling/state analysis: initial empty and clear/reset states share the failure; both creation modes share this consumer. Ordinary required choices are not initially satisfied; the level-up CLI already displays optional choices and explicit skip behavior and does not share this failure.

Evidence: read-only Node 24 source probes (native TypeScript and in-memory .js-to-.ts resolution, no repository files created) reproduced the actual wizard output/clear transition. Additional probes passed actual-pack Favored Enemy re-derivation equality, creation finalization with humanoid races/language, changing humanoids to beasts removing the dependent race pick, repeated humanoids at levels 6 and 14 with distinct/held-race exclusion and language application, duplicate-race rejection, and optional-language/Common exclusion for every bundled ancestry. auditSrdStructure and auditSrdPlayability returned []; git diff --check passed. Generated record comparison: 0 added, 0 removed, only feature:ranger:favored-enemy changed. Existing importer assertions are strengthened by the guarded full-text fixtures rather than weakened.

Verification limit: this worktree has no node_modules, so Vitest, full gates, and PDF regeneration were not rerun. PR-reported full verification and reproducibility are claims inspected alongside the implementation; native probes above are bounded independent evidence, not a replacement full-suite claim. No source-fidelity, persistence, Natural Explorer, compatibility, or additional acceptance defect found in the remainder of the authorized scope. No NON-MATERIAL findings recorded.
